intent: Keep vendor patch and institutional disclosure on separate dated lines. Their coexistence does not justify a whole-system victory mark.
source:
**Frame:** A vendor patch leaves JFrog's release pipeline while OpenAI's disclosure arrives on a separate line. No triumphant checkmark covers the whole system.

**Caption:**
> JFROG SAYS IT VALIDATED AND RELEASED FIXES AFTER OPENAI DISCLOSED THE VULNERABILITIES.

**Provenance:** `documented` (institutional claim) — JFrog's account of its own response.
title: A vendor patch and disclosure follow separate lines
